At Terma, we develop advanced technologies and mission-critical systems that protect people on land, at sea, in the air, and in space. As we expand to meet new global challenges, we’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to help us evolve the infrastructure that powers secure, scalable, and high-impact software solutions across the defense and aerospace domains.
 
Your role in our team 
 As part of our platform modernization journey, you'll play a key role in shaping the next generation of Terma’s internal developer platform – from tooling and architecture to deployment and DevSecOps practices. This is a hands-on engineering role where your contributions will directly impact developer experience and operational effectiveness across the company. 
You will join a growing, collaborative DevSecOps team of six professionals known for their technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and good humour. Together, you'll enable dynamic development environments and modern CI/CD pipelines through automation, infrastructure-as-code, and security best practices.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution 
 Your key responsibilities include:
·         Design, build, and optimize core platform services to support secure development workflows
·         Automate provisioning of compliant developer environments and deployment pipelines
·         Maintain and evolve the platform using tools such as Kubernetes, Ansible, GitLab, Jenkins, and SonarQube
·         Advocate for cloud-native and GitOps principles, driving best practices in automation and scaling
·         Help shape the future of our internal developer platform, contributing ideas, best practices, and architecture decisions
·         Contribute to team learning by sharing knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and learning sessions
 
 Bring your world class expertise into play
 
You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications: 
·         Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, and YAML
·         Hands-on knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker, Podman)
·         Solid understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps, and GitOps methodologies
·         Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code practices (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI) and automation
·         A cloud-native mindset, emphasizing scalability, resilience, and security
 
Preferred but not required qualifications include: 
·         Experience designing or operating on-premise infrastructure and self-hosted systems (e.g., GitLab, Kubernetes)
·         Familiarity with tools such as Gerrit, Jenkins, Nexus, and SonarQube
·         Comfortable working in Linux-based environments, including shell scripting and troubleshooting
·         Basic understanding of networking and system administration concepts (e.g., DNS, firewalls, certificates, reverse proxies)
·         Previous work in regulated or high-security environments
·         Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
 
Please note: While we adopt a cloud-native approach, all infrastructure at Terma is hosted on-premise. We do not use public cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure), and familiarity with self-managed environments is a strong advantage.
As a person, you take initiative, own your work, and actively seek continuous learning. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams and communicate with clarity and empathy. You ask smart questions, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better decisions. You’re comfortable debugging complex systems, documenting solutions, and sharing insights, and you also bring positive energy to a supportive, team-oriented environment. 
We are an international company delivering complex, high-tech products with a meaningful mission: securing people through advanced technology. You'll work alongside world-class experts on challenging tasks – and we’ll support your growth with tailored learning opportunities that strengthen both your technical and personal development.
We value autonomy, engagement, and flexibility, and we believe that great work comes from empowered people. When you join Terma, we promise great people, challenging tasks, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.
 
Benefits at Terma
 
At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.
International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world
Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy the opportunity to work flexibly and the option to work from home up to two days per week. Internet connection at home is paid by Terma.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.
Well-being Perks: Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark 
Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arrange a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.
Competence networking across professional experts in Terma: Professional presentations and knowledge sharing across the organization

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Job Description

At Netcompany, we’re looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social, and fast-developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Do you want to help build some of Denmark’s most complex and business-critical IT solutions — in a role where software development, project management, and close client collaboration shape your everyday work?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Application Services and Consulting. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best — either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & Technologies

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll help translate client needs into the right technical solutions. We use the technologies that best fit the project and the client, so it’s important that you enjoy working with new and varied technologies and domains while continuously developing your skill set.

A large part of our projects are based on web technologies such as Angular or React, combined with Java or C# on Java or .NET platforms. We also work with several enterprise platforms including Microsoft, Salesforce, IBM, Oracle, Adobe, Snowflake, Guidewire, and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle with a strong technical focus. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your day-to-day work will typically include:

• Building and developing frameworks and integrations

• Implementing features in the user interface

• Configuring and developing extensions for enterprise platforms

• Automating business processes, for example through batch jobs

• Developing tools and scripts for large-scale data migrations

You’ll join a team with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise — what we all have in common is a strong technical mindset and a shared ambition to build the best possible IT solutions together.

Our projects include some of Denmark’s most innovative and mission-critical IT initiatives across the public and private sectors, meaning you’ll help shape and improve everyday life for a large part of society.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are a recent graduate or have a few years of experience — the most important thing is your motivation to take your IT career to the next level

• Have solid technical skills within object-oriented programming

• Have a foundational understanding of software development and a strong willingness to grow your competencies

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way

• Full professional proficiency in Swedish and English (written and spoken) is a must. As you will be working closely with Danish clients and colleagues, you should be able to communicate and collaborate effectively in a Danish work environment.

Continue your development with us

At Netcompany, we invest heavily in both your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you’ll be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development journey and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure both professional growth and personal well-being, while also giving you insight into the many career paths available as you gain experience.

You’ll also take part in our training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you’ll have access to courses and seminars covering everything from technologies to client management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that the content is highly relevant and directly connected to your professional development. This prepares you for a wide range of responsibilities and continuously strengthens your expertise throughout your career with us.

Become part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, community matters. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture built on collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing, where there is always room for sparring and support.

As part of our culture and values, all employees — regardless of background, identity, or experience — are treated with respect and understanding and given equal opportunities to grow and thrive.

You’ll also have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from different cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices across multiple countries.

We offer an environment where collaboration happens across teams and projects, combined with a wide range of social and professional events that help you expand and build your network early in your career.

Apply now

Upload your CV and application through our recruitment system via the link. If you still have questions, feel free to contact us at hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion or belief, political opinion, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at  reasonableadjustmentsdk@netcompany.com  for assistance.

**The Role

The Director contributes to clinical development strategies and plans.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Job Description Summary

Activities contributing to the design, development, and lifecycle support of products, solutions, and systems. Includes activities linked to new product development and technical improvement of existing products and components. The role impacts approaches, projects, and programs within the functional area and supports both R&D and manufacturing activities. Impacts quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team. Has significant input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. Guided by professional practices and policies while requiring a high level of operational judgment.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

• Responsible for electronic hardware design and engineering, including designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating electronic circuits, assemblies, and subsystems for medical devices and other hardware systems. Common skill sets include Power Electronics, Analog, Digital, Mixed Signal, Power Management, Battery Systems, DC/DC Converters, Microcontrollers, and Embedded Hardware.

• Develop specialized knowledge within the power electronics discipline and serve as a technical resource within the team. Maintain awareness of the latest technical developments and contribute to engineering strategy, best practices, and technology decisions.

• Apply technical expertise to design robust, reliable, and manufacturable electronic solutions. Perform circuit analysis, hardware debugging, verification testing, root cause investigations, and evaluation of design alternatives.

• Support products throughout their lifecycle, including manufacturing support, production issue resolution, component obsolescence management, design improvements, and implementation of engineering changes.

• Use judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems across product development, manufacturing, quality, and supplier interactions. Take a practical and data-driven approach to identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

• Participate in Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) activities, including impact assessments, technical documentation, verification planning, and implementation of design changes.

• Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information and works across functions to build consensus and drive technical solutions.

Required Qualifications

• Experience in Engineering/Technology and Electronic Hardware knowledge level is comparable to a Master's degree from an university or college (or equivalent relevant experience).

jobs.description:
Vi søger pædagogmedhjælpere til Børnehuset Hyldespjældet i Albertslund

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. Lige nu søger vi pædagogmedhjælpere til Børnehuset Hyldespjældet

Vil du være med til at give de yngste børn en tryg start på livet – i et mindre børnehus, hvor nærvær, natur og fællesskab er en del af hverdagen?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi er et mindre integreret børnehus med to vuggestuegrupper og to børnehavegrupper. Vores størrelse betyder, at alle kender hinanden – børn, forældre og medarbejdere. Det skaber et trygt, overskueligt miljø med tætte relationer og et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.
Et børnehus med naturen som læringsrum

Børnehuset Hyldespjældet er omgivet af grønne områder, og naturen er en naturlig del af vores pædagogiske hverdag. Vi bruger vores store legeplads, nærmiljøet og Vestskoven aktivt og giver børnene mulighed for at udforske verden gennem leg, bevægelse og sanseoplevelser – året rundt.

Vi tror på, at børn lærer bedst, når de er nysgerrige, trygge og en del af stærke fællesskaber.
Vi er flyttet hjem til flotte, nyrenoverede rammer

Efter en gennemgribende renovering har vi fået lyse, moderne og inspirerende rammer med gode muligheder for både leg, fordybelse og nærvær. Rammerne understøtter vores pædagogiske arbejde og giver plads til både børn og medarbejdere.
Vi arbejder med høj faglighed

Hos os er relationen til barnet udgangspunktet for alt, hvad vi gør. Vores pædagogik  tager afsæt i børnenes perspektiver, leg og deltagelsesmuligheder. Vi tror på refleksion, faglig sparring og udvikling af praksis – sammen.
Vi søger en kollega, som

• Brænder for arbejdet med de yngste børn.
• Er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og tydelig.
• Har blik for børnefællesskaber og det enkelte barns udvikling.
• Har lyst til at bruge naturen som en aktiv del af hverdagen.
• Er nysgerrig, engageret og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.
• Har lyst til at udvikle den pædagogiske praksis sammen med kolleger.Vi tilbyder

• En fast stilling i børnehuset på 37 timer om ugen.
• Et mindre børnehus med korte beslutningsveje og tæt samarbejde.
• Et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab med humor, omsorg og høj faglighed.
• Gode muligheder for indflydelse på hverdagen og den pædagogiske udvikling.
• Nyrenoverede rammer og et inspirerende udeområde.
• Engagerede kolleger og et tæt samarbejde med forældrene.
• En grundig introduktion til huset og dine nye kolleger.

Judithe Nielsen, Leder

Børnehuset Hyldespjældet

2620 Albertslund

Arbejdsstedet Børnehuset Hyldespjældet, storetorv 40, 2620 Albertslund

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. Our team oversees compliance risks across a broad range of areas, including the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk, as well as non-financial risk areas such as ICT, operational risk, model risk, data governance and strategy, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across the financial risk areas of capital, market risk, liquidity and credit risk as well as non-financial areas such as operational risk, model risk and strategic risks in relation to policies, procedures, segregation of duties, limits, calculations, samples, controls, etc.

However, if you are curious about the other areas covered by the team, we will help you develop your skills and knowledge within these areas.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

**

Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation is a strategic transformation role responsible for strengthening People Operations and Payroll through improved data governance, process effectiveness, operational controls, reporting, systems enablement and automation. The role is not accountable for day-to-day operational execution; instead, it focuses on designing, improving and implementing sustainable, scalable and efficient ways of working across People Operations and Payroll.

The role owns the continuous improvement of People Experience across key operational touchpoints, including preboarding, offboarding, leave management, query management, employee lifecycle administration and employee and manager satisfaction measurement. While the role remains closely connected to operational realities, this is through data, insights, stakeholder feedback and process review rather than direct operational delivery.

As the primary subject matter expert for People Operations and Payroll data quality, operational controls, systems enablement and transformation initiatives, the Specialist is accountable for strengthening data integrity, applying a Six Sigma approach to measuring process effectiveness, establishing sustainable controls, improving operational reporting and driving automation. This includes supporting the implementation of ServiceNow HRSD, introducing automated workflows and working closely with GBS to identify opportunities for robots and automation that reduce manual effort and improve service consistency.

The role works closely with GO People Operations, Payroll, GBS, People Experience, Employee Relations, and other relevant stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable processes, technology enhancements, automated workflows and more efficient ways of working. The role also brings external insight into People Operations and Payroll by identifying best practice, latest research and inspiration from other organisations to continuously improve the employee and manager experience.

Strategic Accountabilities

• Service design and operating model: Define and improve scalable People Operations and Payroll processes, service standards, ownership models, hand-offs and escalation routes in line with the One Team model and the future tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Data governance and controls: Establish governance standards, control requirements, reconciliation principles and audit-ready evidence standards across People Operations and Payroll.

• Systems and HRSD enablement: Own strategic requirements for SuccessFactors and ServiceNow HRSD, translating business needs into process design, workflow requirements, system enhancements, testing, training and adoption plans.

• Automation and robotics: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, variation and repetitive work through automated workflows, robotics and close collaboration with GBS.

• Insights and continuous improvement: Use KPIs, process measures, satisfaction data, stakeholder feedback, external best practice and latest research to identify priorities and drive sustained improvement.

• Change and implementation: Lead structured implementation of transformation initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, change planning, adoption and handover into business ownership.

Key Success Measures

• Improved data accuracy, control effectiveness and audit readiness across People Operations and Payroll.

• Reduced manual effort, errors, rework and process variation through automation, robotics and improved workflows.

• Successful implementation and adoption of ServiceNow HRSD and the tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Clearer service ownership, escalation routes, standards and hand-offs across People Operations, Payroll and relevant People Experience touchpoints.

• Improved employee and manager satisfaction through simpler, more consistent and insight-led service delivery.

• Use of a Six Sigma-inspired measurement approach to define baselines, track errors and rework, identify root causes and evidence sustained process improvement.

• Delivery of agreed transformation milestones with sustainable handover into business ownership.

Fit within the One Team People Operations Model

• Employees and managers are supported collectively by the operational People Operations and Payroll teams, rather than through dedicated Business Unit alignment.

• The wider People Operations role design preserves the One Team model while creating clearer specialist ownership and protected capacity for agreed focus areas.

• Operational specialists and associate specialists deliver day-to-day employee and manager services; this role complements them by creating the conditions for those services to become more scalable, automated, data-led and consistent.

• This role strengthens the foundations that enable consistent service delivery, including standards, governance, controls, reporting, automation, systems, HRSD enablement and service design.

• Day-to-day operational execution remains with the relevant operational teams; this role focuses on strategic improvement, implementation and enablement.

• Transformation priorities are informed by operational insight from operational teams, Payroll, Employee Relations, People Experience, GBS and People Experience & Services, but remain focused on scalable, future-ready solutions rather than live case delivery.

Fit within the Wider People Experience Team

The Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation also plays an important enabling role across the wider People Experience team. While the role is anchored in People Operations and Payroll transformation, its impact extends across People Experience, Employee Relations and Talent Acquisition because these areas are connected through shared employee and manager journeys, service touchpoints, data, systems and process hand-offs.

Within the wider People Experience team, this role helps turn strategic priorities into practical, scalable service improvements. It supports a more joined-up employee and manager experience by identifying where processes, technology, automation, knowledge, controls and service standards need to be better connected across the full employee lifecycle — from attraction and hiring through preboarding, employment, employee relations matters, leave management, query resolution and offboarding.

• People Operations and Payroll: strengthens the core service delivery model through data governance, automation, HRSD implementation, controls, reporting and process effectiveness.

• People Experience: ensures operational touchpoints are designed around a simple, consistent and positive employee and manager experience, using satisfaction data, best practice and external insights to inform improvements.

• Employee Relations: works closely with the Manager, Employee Relations to ensure processes, hand-offs, documentation, escalation routes and service standards support compliant, consistent and sensitive handling of employee matters.

• Talent Acquisition: connects hiring, preboarding and onboarding touchpoints so candidates, new joiners, hiring managers and People teams experience a clear, consistent and well-managed transition into employment.

In this way, the role acts as a strategic connector across the wider People Experience team. It does not own the functional agendas of People Experience, Employee Relations or Talent Acquisition, but it helps ensure that the processes, systems, data, automation and service design behind those agendas are joined up, measurable and scalable. This makes the role critical to building a more consistent, insight-led and future-ready employee and manager experience across the organisation.
